Method of Attack: Exploitation of remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability to plant a PHP web shell that runs arbitrary commands on compromised Elastix VoIP telephony servers
Use of initial exploitation scripts to drop a small shell script that installs a PHP backdoor, creates root user accounts, and ensures persistence via scheduled tasks
Spoofing timestamps of installed PHP backdoor files to blend into the environment
Scheduled task running every minute to fetch a base64 encoded PHP web shell managing remote login, command execution, and Asterisk CLI calls
Impacted Systems: Elastix server software for unified communications
Indicators of Compromise: More than 500,000 unique malware samples deployed between December 2021 and March 2022
IP addresses of attackers located in the Netherlands
DNS records linked to several Russian adult sites
Local file paths, unique strings, hashes for shell scripts, and public URLs hosting payloads as per Unit42 report
